_readme: S730 title hunt (elumen_2 group), 2026-11-25. Sam asked on 2026-11-25 for each college's printed local subject titles (the catalog's heading for each course subject code), which decide a local code's common subject (kb/subject_title_hunt/README.md). S712 (run 45166049971) found an eLumen catalog's courses view prints every subject as 'Name - CODE'. This read loads this catalog's courses view, rendered, and prints it line for line with the links that name a course or catalog, so a session files the headings without reading every course. One page load, no model call, writes nothing.

questions.subject_index: Where the catalog prints each course subject code with its name (the courses view's subject list), and the names as printed.

outside_hosts.api-prod.elumenapp.com: eLumen's own API host: the catalog's scripts fetch every view from it (kb/_program_requirements_college.py, the eLumen note; S380).
